```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(grid)
```

#### Load dataset
```{r}
national <- read_excel("national_M2021_dl.xlsx") %>% clean_names()
```

## Audience
My audience is the general public, anyone interested in employment in the health field. My visualizations allow you to find the most advantageous professions in terms of employment and salary. 
There is no need to have any previous knowledge before understanding my visualizations.


## Visualization 1
```{r}
g1<-national %>% 
  distinct(occ_title, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(str_detect(occ_code,"29-")) %>%
  arrange(desc(tot_emp)) %>%
  mutate(prop=round(tot_emp*100/sum(tot_emp))) %>%
  slice(1:5) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=prop, y=reorder(occ_title,prop)))+
  geom_col()+
  annotate("segment", y=0.5, yend=5.7, x=15, xend = 15, color="darkred", linewidth=1, alpha=0)+
  geom_text(aes(label=paste(prop,"%")), hjust=1., size=5, color="white", face=rep(c("bold"))) +
  labs(title="Occupations with the most estimated employment",
       subtitle="Top 5 by proportion of estimated employment in 2021",
       y="Occupations",
       x=NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  # remove legend
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        #axis.text = element_text(size=11.5),
        # remove tick marks
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        # remove major horizontal grids
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        # remove both minor grids
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text=element_text(size=11.5, face=rep(c("bold"))))
  
```

## Visualization 2
```{r}
g2 <- national %>% 
  distinct(occ_title, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(mean_wage=mean(as.numeric(a_mean), na.rm = TRUE))%>%
  filter(str_detect(occ_code,"29-")) %>%
  arrange(desc(tot_emp)) %>%
  mutate(prop=round(tot_emp*100/sum(tot_emp)),
         highlight=as.numeric(a_mean)>mean_wage) %>%
  slice(1:5) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=reorder(occ_title,prop), y=as.numeric(a_mean), fill=highlight))+
  geom_col()+
  geom_text(aes(label=paste(as.numeric(a_mean), "$")), hjust=1.2, size=5, color="white", face=rep(c("bold")))+
  annotate("segment", x=0.5, xend=5.7, y=67382.66, yend = 67382.66, color="darkred", linewidth=1.5)+
  annotate("segment", y = 75000, yend = 68383, x = 1.5, xend = 1.5,
           size = 1.5, arrow = arrow(length = unit(.25,"cm")))+
  annotate( "text", y=72000, x=1.5, label="Mean Wage in U.S.",hjust=-0.2, size=6)+
  coord_flip()+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("gray30", "darkgreen")) +
  labs(title="Annual Wage in Health Occupations",
       subtitle="Mean annual wage in top 5 Health Occupations",
       y=NULL,
       x=NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(# remove legend
        legend.position = "none",
        # remove text marks
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        # remove tick marks
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        # remove major horizontal grids
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        # remove both minor grids
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
        )

```


```{r, fig.width=18, fig.height=5}
library(gridExtra)
#grid.arrange(g1,g2, nrow=2)
g<-grid.arrange(g1,g2, ncol=2)
ggsave("plot.png", g)
```
